input: CT radiology images, H&E histopathology microscopy images, clinical metadata (age, sex, smoking history)
output: Lung cancer subtype classification probabilities (adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, large cell carcinoma, small cell lung cancer, normal tissue)
notable: Integrates radiological and histopathological modalities via weighted decision-level fusion; employs XAI techniques (Grad-CAM, Grad-CAM++, etc.) for interpretability; uses EfficientNet/ResNet backbones and MIL with attention pooling for histopathology.
